name: Oven-Roasted Salmon Steak with Celeriac Purée & Pancetta (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Animator's Palate (Animation Magic Night 2)
whyItWorks: Anti-inflammatory omega-3 salmon paired with silky root-vegetable purée; much gentler than fibrous brassica sides.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to swap the celeriac purée for plain mashed potatoes or white rice if celery root triggers FODMAP gas, and skip crispy pancetta bits.
